items.claim: Jamal Hill has gained significant weight and will not make the 205-pound limit again.
items.quote: Jamal Hill is fat as hell. He's never coming back down um to 205 ever again.

items.claim: Paulo Costa will win his fight and continue to perform well at 205 pounds.
items.quote: I think Bohachinho wins and Bachiniah is going to continue to be really good at 205.

items.claim: Robert Whittaker can legitimately beat Dominic Reyes in a potential matchup.
items.quote: It's a fight I legitimately think Rob can win.
